# LLM Gateway

> Edge-native multi-provider LLM gateway on Aliyun ESA Functions & Pages. One edge endpoint unifies OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible upstreams with priority routing, automatic failover, circuit breaking, prompt-injection defense, and unified key management.

## Gateway data plane

- [OpenAI Chat Completions](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/edge-security-acceleration/esa/user-guide/what-is-functions-and-pages/): `POST /api/v1/chat/completions`
- [Anthropic Messages](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/edge-security-acceleration/esa/user-guide/what-is-functions-and-pages/): `POST /api/v1/messages`
- Model list: `GET /api/v1/models`

## Console control plane (session-token protected)

- Auth: `POST /api/admin/login`, `GET /api/admin/me`, `POST /api/admin/change-password`
- Providers: `GET/POST /api/admin/providers`, `PUT/DELETE /api/admin/providers/:id`
- Keys: `GET/POST /api/admin/keys`, `PUT/DELETE /api/admin/keys/:id`, `POST /api/admin/keys/:id/rotate`
- Policies: `GET/PUT /api/admin/policies`
- Logs: `GET/DELETE /api/admin/logs`
- Ops: `GET /api/admin/stats`, `POST /api/admin/reset-health`, `POST /api/admin/test`
